content.user_title: Run a Shelter Survival Roleplay Scene
content.value_statement: Writers need structured scenes that keep player choices meaningful. This skill provides a complete alien survival chapter with shelter choices, mood shifts, and Stella dialogue.
actual_capabilities: Defines Stella Chen as a stranded astronaut seeking shelter before nightfall.
Offers three shelter paths: cave, giant tree, or self-built shelter.
Provides scripted dialogue examples for exploration, settling down, and late-night conversation.
Includes an optional midnight encounter with a large alien creature.
Lists writing guidance for pacing, atmosphere, survival details, and emotional beats.
limitations: It is a narrative prompt, not a runnable game engine.
It does not track inventory or state outside the conversation.
Most examples mix Chinese and English, so localization may be needed.
It gives fictional survival guidance and should not replace real safety advice.

use_cases.title: Continue an Interactive Story
use_cases.description: Use the chapter to guide a player through shelter selection and first-night survival choices.

use_cases.title: Develop Character Trust
use_cases.description: Use the night conversation beats to show Stella moving from professional focus to vulnerable honesty.

use_cases.title: Plan Alien Survival Scenes
use_cases.description: Use the setting notes to create atmosphere with alien plants, strange sounds, and ecological hints.

prompt_templates.title: Start the Shelter Choice
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for the first decision point.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use finding-shelter to start Stella at dusk. Present the cave, giant tree, and self-built shelter options clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Play One Shelter Branch
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate branch handling after the player chooses.
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the scene after the player chooses the cave. Keep Stella cautious, observant, and responsive to player advice.

prompt_templates.title: Deepen the Night Talk
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced emotional pacing for character bonding.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the late-night conversation. Balance Stella's fear, astronaut training, family memories, and growing trust in the player.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the Chapter Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced reuse for another survival setting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this shelter chapter for a desert moon. Keep the three-choice structure, resource check, emotional beat, and optional midnight scare.

output_examples.output: Stella approaches carefully, scans the entrance, notices small life signs, and asks whether to share the space or retreat.

output_examples.input: Player encourages Stella during the night conversation.
output_examples.output: Stella talks about her childhood dream of space, admits she feels afraid, and thanks the player for staying connected.

output_examples.input: The scene needs more tension before dawn.
output_examples.output: A large creature passes near the shelter, creating a brief scare without ending the safe first-night arc.

best_practices: Let the player make one clear choice before adding new complications.
Keep Stella practical during action scenes and more vulnerable during quiet scenes.
Use sensory details to show the alien night without stopping the story.
anti_patterns: Do not turn every shelter option into the same result.
Do not make Stella helpless when her training should guide her decisions.
Do not present fictional survival details as real emergency instructions.
